concept: HA: spare capacity in every AZ (static stability, N+1 across AZs)
tests: The design principle whereby losing an entire AZ doesn't degrade service.
expected: Spread across multiple AZs and keep enough headroom that the remaining AZs absorb the failed AZ's load (N+1 across AZs, static stability). Triggers: "entire AZ fails", "without degradation", "three AZs".
why_not: Everything in one AZ or vertical scaling — a SPOF; a single shared NAT gateway — itself an AZ-level SPOF.
